title: Clone the playground
summary: Clone the repository, create a feature branch, and confirm git status is clean on main.

title: Make your first commit
summary: Edit a workshop file, inspect the diff, and create a clear conventional commit.

title: Ship from a feature branch
summary: Create a named branch for an Issue, push it, and open a Pull Request against main.

title: Sign the wall
summary: Edit the same three lines as everyone else. Resolve the conflict that follows.

title: Collaborate across teams
summary: Request a review from another team and leave a constructive comment on their PR.

title: Review like a maintainer
summary: Approve or request changes on a peer PR. Explain why, not just what.

title: Make CI green
summary: Inspect a failing GitHub Actions run, fix the cause, and push so CI reruns.

title: Recover production
summary: Use git log, show, blame, and revert to find and undo the change that degraded production.

title: Bisect a regression
summary: Use git bisect to locate the commit that introduced a workshop bug.

title: Cut a workshop release
summary: Help draft release notes from merged PRs and tag a version after maintainer merge.

title: Contribute from a fork
summary: Leave the org workflow. Fork, add upstream, and open a pull request from your copy.

title: Look at the network
summary: The graph should now look like an engineering organization. Find your node and the edges you created.
